sequences.name: Series B/C CEO Outreach

sequences.name: CHRO & VP Talent Nurture
sequences.description: Long-form nurture sequence targeting HR leaders at growth-stage companies (200-1500 employees). Highest quality MQL source.

sequences.name: Repeat Client Check-in
sequences.description: Warm re-engagement sequence for past clients 90-180 days post-placement. Celebrates placement success, shares market updates, and opens the door for next search. Highest reply rate in our sequence portfolio — these are warm relationships. Often triggers repeat business within 30 days of enrollment.

sequences.name: Tech Leadership Market Update
